common: Create a standalone premium production illustration for the Chinese enterprise-AI project 莫比乌斯. Use the reference ONLY as the visual-family guide: immaculate icy-blue probability clouds, exquisitely fine photonic filaments, small luminous white points, optical depth and scientific precision. New original composition for this specific business direction. Square image around1536x1536, uniformly pale cool #f6f7f8 background to the edges, the object completely visible and centered within80% of the canvas, generous clear margins. No typography, labels, numbers, UI, logos, frame or watermark. Pure light and particles, never a continuous solid material, never chrome/metal/glass/plastic. Use some medium-blue structural filaments so it remains clear at450px display width. Dimensional and art-directed, not a flat wireframe or coarse uniform dot cloud. Preserve the quiet mature atmosphere of the reference. No four-plane-stack repetition for these new images.

descriptions.agents: Represent intelligent-agent construction and composition. Three distinct fine streams of blue-white knowledge/light approach from different directions, then weave together into one elegant, structured braided flow. Give the composition a subtle half twist and looping depth, a few refined luminous junctions, with the flow still visibly made of thousands of fine filaments and probability particles. The metaphor is models, tools and workflows composing into coordinated action. No robot or human icons, no arrows, no diagram boxes.
descriptions.knowledge: Represent shared enterprise knowledge as a refined three-dimensional constellation. Several softly volumetric clusters of tiny blue-white probability particles connect through delicate luminous filaments into one coherent open spherical knowledge field. Rich but edited detail, different cluster densities and depth, several precise bright junctions. A substantial central connected structure, not a random spray, no literal brain silhouette, no balls made of solid glass, no flat network icon.
descriptions.semantics: Business semantics: a precise open RECTILINEAR three-dimensional lattice of tiny photonic nodes and thin straight blue connections. Several separated sparse rectangular coordinate sheets intersect at right angles and create a compact airy structured network, built ONLY from luminous lines and particles. NO infinity symbol, NO curved ribbon, NO spherical globe, NO Möbius loop, NO solid cube. The geometry should clearly communicate objects, relationships and constraints, with generous open space between the layers. Original geometric composition, not the shape of the reference.
descriptions.voice: Represent contextual voice interaction as one sculptural flowing band of finely spaced luminous wave filaments, with elegant changes in amplitude, passing through a subtle open orbital ring of probability particles. Natural, fluid, coherent and richly dimensional. The metaphor is natural conversation turning into understanding and action. Cool white highlights and ice-blue wave strands, varied fine particles. No microphone, headphone, person, literal sound UI or chart axes.
descriptions.personalization: Personalized service: one luminous central probability cluster with three or four small asymmetrically arranged satellite clusters, joined by delicate elliptical orbital light paths. An elegant relational composition in oblique3D, with each satellite separate and the relationships coherent. The center is a constellation of light, not a physical ball. No infinity sign, no Möbius ribbon, no human avatars, no real planet textures, no four-layer planes. This visual represents one continuing individual relationship across several service touchpoints.
descriptions.capture: Capturing expertise: wisps of diffuse probabilistic light approach from the left and gradually resolve into a few beautifully ordered branching trajectories at the right. The chaotic-to-structured transition is clear within one refined continuous composition: softly scattered experiences become aligned fine photonic paths with a few precise white-blue junctions. No infinity shape, no Möbius loop, no circular globe, no solid objects, no book/document/recording icons and no literal arrow. Maintain luminous airy three-dimensional detail and clear, sophisticated shape.
descriptions.improvement: Continuous learning and improvement: an elegant oblique CIRCULAR closed loop of extremely fine white-blue photonic filaments and small probability particles, with a large open central void. Three subtle brighter concentrations along the same circulating path show feedback progressing around a cycle. Nested counter-flow strands add depth. It must be a clear annular cycle in perspective, NOT an infinity shape, NOT a thick filled ribbon, NOT a solid torus or metal ring. Light streams and particles only, with a softly diffuse halo and very controlled blue structure.
